mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.name, t.created_at, COUNT(ft.favorite_id) AS count FROM chat_tag t LEFT JOIN chat_favorite_tag ft ON ft.tag_id = t.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY t.id, t.user_id, t.name, t.created_at ORDER BY t.id ASC
SELECT id, user_id, name, created_at FROM chat_tag WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_tag WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
